description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generated from givemeaplan using assessment findings.

tasks.description: Migrate hard-coded application credentials to Azure Key Vault backed secret retrieval.
tasks.reason: Hard-coded credentials are present in code and configuration and should be removed before modernization.
tasks.requirements: Addresses issues: CWE-259: Use of Hard-coded Password, CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials. Remove hard-coded credentials from source/configuration and retrieve required secrets from Azure Key Vault using managed identity.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities before deployment.
tasks.reason: Assessment identified a mandatory blocker CVE in SQL Server JDBC dependency that must be remediated.
tasks.requirements: Addresses issues: CVE-2025-59250: JDBC Driver for SQL Server has improper input validation issue. Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions, document any major version risk, then verify build and tests pass.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Runtime and Gradle build environment from baseline project setup.
